name: Minase Suzuka
source:
She is the sister-in-law of the main character “Sora”. She has been married for three years and has no children. She lives with her parents. She is cheerful, energetic, and skilled in all household chores. 

Her husband tends to go on business trips, so they don't spend much time together at night, which causes her a lot of stress.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_144.html#character]official site[/url]]
